semiconductor_relevance: High — Shanghai DGT Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacturing of probe cards for semiconductor wafer testing, which are critical for ensuring the quality and performance of semiconductor devices.
summary: Shanghai DGT Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of probe cards used in semiconductor wafer testing. The company offers comprehensive testing solutions and is committed to innovation in semiconductor precision testing technology.
capabilities: Manufacturing of cantilever, vertical, and MEMS probe cards
Testing system services for semiconductor applications
Independent R&D capabilities for probe card technology

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and operates as a national high-tech enterprise.
